jump_height_definitions.NAME: COM_RISE_TAKEOFF_TO_APEX
jump_height_definitions.RATIONALE: Direct model-truth displacement; no force threshold, no integration drift, no flight-time assumption

jump_height_definitions.NAME: BALLISTIC_HEIGHT_FROM_TAKEOFF_VZ
jump_height_definitions.RATIONALE: Impulse-momentum-equivalent estimate; differs from A only by internal segment motion during flight

jump_height_definitions.NAME: FLIGHT_TIME_HEIGHT
jump_height_definitions.DEFINITION: g * T_flight_physical^2 / 8 with T_flight_physical = LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT_TIME - PHYSICAL_TAKEOFF_TIME; g = 9.81 m/s^2 (project constant)
jump_height_definitions.RATIONALE: Assumes equal COM heights at takeoff and landing and no posture asymmetry; retained only for comparison with flight-time-method studies

jump_height_definitions.NAME: COM_APEX_ABOVE_INITIAL_STANDING
jump_height_definitions.RATIONALE: Standing-to-apex definition family; never interchangeable with A

jump_height_definitions.NAME: FORCE_INTEGRATED_COM_DISPLACEMENT
jump_height_definitions.DEFINITION: double integration of (Fz_whole - m*g)/m from initial standing to apex
jump_height_definitions.RATIONALE: Experimental double-integration equivalent; verification diagnostic in simulation

naming_rules.apex_com_z: absolute world coordinate, never called a height
naming_rules.retired_conflation: 0.0363 m and 0.0752 m may never share one jump-height label (ERR-001)

CANDIDATES.LABEL: PF-1
CANDIDATES.BASIS: Kraska 2009 PMID 20029097: strong-group 20 kg CMJ 27.57 +/- 8.64 cm (mean-SD ~18.9 cm); 0 kg CMJ group means 28.3-33.5 cm; weak-stratum 20 kg mean not directly reported; derived estimate ~19-20 cm by applying the weak group's larger SJ percent decrease (~30.4% vs 17.8%); 0.150 m is ~20-25% below that derived estimate and ~2x R001's 0.0752 m; CROSS-FAMILY LIMITATION: human values are flight-time JH, gate is direct COM displacement (plausibility band, not calibration)
CANDIDATES.FALSE_PASS_PREVENTED: trivial hop, force-threshold artifact, 3.6-7.5 cm hop
CANDIDATES.TRADEOFF: conservative task-plausibility floor, not a performance target

CANDIDATES.LABEL: PF-2
CANDIDATES.BASIS: near the derived weak-stratum 20 kg estimate (~19-20 cm)
CANDIDATES.TRADEOFF: may exceed rebuilt Plant/controller capability; converts task floor into performance target

CANDIDATES.LABEL: PF-3
CANDIDATES.TRADEOFF: 12-15 cm hop would qualify; weak scientific statement

CANDIDATES.LABEL: PF-4
CANDIDATES.BASIS: no numeric floor frozen; numeric deferred until after RES-83 capability known

primary_performance_gate.INVALID_OUTCOME_PREVENTED: trivial hop qualifying as a loaded countermovement jump

physics_consistency_gates.NAME: FLIGHT_ACCELERATION_CONSISTENCY
physics_consistency_gates.DEFINITION: In the physical flight interval, mean(d(com_vz)/dt) + g within +/- epsilon_acc, excluding samples adjacent to contact

physics_consistency_gates.NAME: BALLISTIC_HEIGHT_RESIDUAL
physics_consistency_gates.DEFINITION: residual = h_direct - h_tov over the certified physical flight interval; because the only external force in flight is gravity, the whole-body COM is ballistic and the residual is numerical only

physics_consistency_gates.NAME: TAKEOFF_TRANSITION_WHIP
physics_consistency_gates.DEFINITION: max abs(root_pitch_rate) over [E5_onset, E6+0.050 s] <= R_WHIP; max abs(trunk_pitch_rate) <= R_WHIP_TRUNK

physics_consistency_gates.NAME: EXTENSION_STATE_AT_TAKEOFF
physics_consistency_gates.DEFINITION: At physical takeoff, hip/knee/ankle configuration lies inside the RES-83-declared robust extension set
physics_consistency_gates.INVALID_OUTCOME_PREVENTED: anatomically invalid takeoff configuration (reverse knee / hip extension)

physics_consistency_gates.NAME: FORCE_PHYSICAL_TAKEOFF_ORDER
physics_consistency_gates.DEFINITION: FORCE_TAKEOFF_LEAD = t_physical_takeoff - t_force_threshold_takeoff; reported, no fence

REQUIREMENTS: E7 confirms with the declared dwell (OD-03)
APEX lies strictly inside the physical-flight interval (E8)
physical flight interval bounded by E6 and E9 contains no foot-floor contact rows
no force-threshold quantity participates in physical flight definition
